statement: Keep in mind that the entropies are operator space entanglement entropies. Due to unitarity we can simplify SA = LA log(q) and SC = LC log(q). It remains to compute SAC . Based on the arguments above we conjecture the expression Z Z XZ SAC = dxA dxD dps(p)δ(xD − xA − ηv(p)t) + . . . η=±
